name: List
statusNote: The standard list is unchanged from M3; expanded-list, reorder-list and reveal-list are new in Expressive.
summary: A continuous, vertical index of text and/or images. Use a standard list for one/two/three-line rows; use the Expressive additions when rows need to grow inline (expanded-list), be manually reordered (reorder-list), or expose swipe actions (reveal-list).

inputs.name: leadingContent
inputs.description: Icon, avatar, image, or video thumbnail.

inputs.name: trailingContent
inputs.description: Trailing icon, trailing supporting text, or a trailing icon-button.

inputs.name: selectionMode
inputs.description: none is a plain informational row; click fires onClick; single-select behaves like a radio row; multi-select is a checked/onCheckedChange toggle row.

inputs.name: checked
inputs.description: multi-select mode: whether this row is toggled on.

inputs.name: onCheckedChange
inputs.description: multi-select mode: called when this row is clicked.

inputs.name: onLongClick
inputs.description: Optional long-press handler, e.g. to enter a reorder or multi-select mode.

inputs.name: segmentIndex
inputs.description: This row's position within a segmented run, used to pick which corners are large-rounded.

inputs.name: segmentCount
inputs.description: The total number of rows in this row's segmented run.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: Selects the token group and interaction model.

anatomy.name: Leading element
anatomy.description: Icon, avatar, image, or video thumbnail.

anatomy.name: Trailing element
anatomy.description: Icon, trailing supporting text, or a trailing icon-button.

variants.description: Row grows to show more content inline (e.g. a detail panel) on expand.
Row is drag-handled to reorder within the list.
Row reveals trailing action button(s) on swipe.

layout.text: Vertical padding inside a row is 8dp for one/two-line rows and 12dp for three-line rows, taken from the item top/bottom space tokens unless the host uses precision-pointer (mouse) sizing, in which case top padding is fixed at 12dp regardless of the token.

A segmented-run helper reshapes only the first/last/single item of a run to the container's large-corner shape while middle items keep the base per-state shape — this produces the "segmented group" look driven by the segmented container colour and segmented gap.
Row height is the max of the token minimum height for its line-count and the natural content height (leading/trailing/text stack), never smaller than the token value.

item-large-leading-video-height/width (64x114) and item-small-leading-video-height/width (56x100) are distinct token pairs for the same leading-video slot at different row emphases — pick one per row, not both.

states.text: Each interaction state (enabled, disabled, hovered, focused, pressed, selected, dragged) has its own label/icon/overline/supporting-text colour and, per state, its own container shape.
Pressed and selected both morph the container to the large corner shape; hovered morphs to the medium corner shape.

states.label: shape-motion
states.text: Shape morph on interaction uses a fast-spatial spring.

states.label: colour-motion
states.text: Container/content colour cross-fade uses a default-effects spring.

states.label: elevation-motion
states.text: Elevation (for reorder drag lift) also animates on the fast-spatial spring.
Selected + disabled combinations have their own dimmed color/opacity tokens, distinct from plain disabled.

Dragged state (reorder) recolors the row to the reorder-list item tokens and reshapes it to the reorder-list item shape (large corner) while lifted, at elevation level4; the drop zone underneath shows the reorder-list drop-zone colour.

behaviour.text: At the pinned Compose commit, only ReorderListTokens are actually wired into ListItemDefaults, as draggedContainerColor/draggedShape parameters on the existing colors()/shapes() builders — a generic "dragged" state, not a reorder-specific composable or drag gesture. ExpandedListTokens and RevealListTokens are not referenced anywhere in ListItem.kt or ListItemDefaults.kt (verified by grep) — there is no public expand or swipe-to-reveal composable yet.

Expanded-list is inferred as an inline expand/collapse: a row grows from collapsed-item-* colors to expanded-item-* colors and reveals more content, toggled by its collapsed-item-trailing-icon ranging to expanded-item-trailing-icon (chevron-style disclosure), with a full/pill trailing-icon-shape on that icon's container.

Reveal-list is inferred as swipe-to-reveal: swiping the row exposes one or more trailing action buttons or a plain icon-button behind the row; releasing past a threshold triggers the action, releasing short of it snaps the row back closed.

Reorder-list's inferred interaction is long-press-and-hold (or a dedicated drag handle icon) to pick up a row, drag to reposition, drop to commit — consistent with the dragged state Compose already exposes.

keyboard: Rows are focusable in document order.
Reorder-list additionally needs a keyboard-operable "move up/move down" affordance since drag alone is not keyboard-accessible.
semantics: The list container is a list/group; each row is a list item, additionally a button/checkbox/radio role when the row itself is actionable/selectable.

Screen reader announces headline, supporting text, selected/checked state, and position-in-set/set-size for the list; a reveal-list row announces its available swipe actions as accessible actions, not only as swipe gestures.

notes.text: Minimum touch target is 48dp, independent of the token row height when a row is shorter (e.g. compact one-line rows).
Geometry/color for expanded-list and reveal-list is token-driven only; the interaction model is inferred from MDC prose and analogy, not sourced from a reference implementation.
